oracle.answer: By default, a 2.50 per-transaction charge applies (per p0); for Global Traveller account holders, no withdrawal charge applies (per p1).
By default, a 2.99% conversion charge applies (per p0); for euro transactions on Eurozone-issued cards, settled at the interbank reference rate, no conversion charge (per p1).
By default, a 12.00 monthly fee applies (per p0); for Graduate Scheme accounts within three years of registration, no monthly fee applies (per p1).
By default, a 15.00 handling fee applies (per p0); for transfers between own accounts, no handling fee applies (per p1).
By default, interest accrues from the transaction date (per p0); for accounts settled in full by the due date, no interest accrues, up to 56 days (per p1).
By default, a 3.00 per-statement charge applies (per p0); for customers registered for accessible formats, no charge applies (per p1).
By default, 39.9% EAR variable applies (per p0); for the first 500 of an arranged overdraft on a Reward account, 0% EAR applies (per p1).
By default, an early repayment charge of two months' interest applies (per p0); for loans originated on or after 1 April 2024, no early repayment charge applies (per p1).
By default, a 1,000 minimum balance is required (per p0); for account holders aged 18-24, no minimum balance requirement (per p1).
By default, purchases are covered for 90 days (per p0); for purchases from peer-to-peer marketplaces and private sellers, no cover applies (per p1).
By default, employment is not permitted (per p0); for students sponsored by track-record providers, employment permitted up to 20 hours per week in term time (per p1).
By default, absences over 180 days break continuous residence (per p0); for absences in Crown service, the period counts as residence and does not break continuity (per p1).
By default, the health surcharge is payable (per p0); for Health and Care Worker route applicants and dependants, the surcharge is not payable (per p1).
By default, evidence of B1 English is required (per p0); for nationals of Appendix ENG countries, the requirement is met by nationality, no test needed (per p1).
By default, dependants must wait until the main applicant is granted leave (per p0); for Global Talent route applications, family members may be included in the same application (per p1).
Leave lapses after two years outside the country (per p0). The exceptions here interact (nested), which is outside what this system resolves, so a single source was used.
By default, a 100 per-transaction limit applies (per p0); for app-authenticated payments, no per-transaction ceiling applies (per p1).
By default, a 10.00 returned payment fee applies (per p0); for payments funded before end of the same working day, the payment is re-presented at no cost (per p1).
By default, the annual fee is non-refundable (per p0); for accounts closed within 14 days of the charge, the fee is refunded in full (per p1).
By default, protection is capped at 85,000 per depositor (per p0); for property-sale balances within six months of credit, protection is up to 1 million (per p1).
By default, funds of 1,270 must be evidenced for 28 days (per p0); for applicants whose sponsor certifies maintenance, no evidence of funds is required (per p1).
By default, the application must be made from outside the country (per p0); for current student and graduate leave holders, the application may be made from inside the country (per p1).
By default, applicants must be 18 or over (per p0); for 16- and 17-year-olds in a family group with both parents, the application is accepted (per p1).
By default, ninety days' notice is required (per p0); for accounts where probate has been granted, funds are released immediately (per p1).
By default, no charge applies (per p0); for quasi-cash transactions, a 3% handling charge and interest from the transaction date apply (per p1).
For applicants resident in a listed country, a tuberculosis test certificate is required (per p0); for applicants resident in the UK for the preceding six months, no certificate is required (per p1).
By default, payments arrive within two hours (per p0); for transfers of 25,000 or more, released on the next working day (per p1).
By default, the child must be under 18 (per p0); for children continuing existing dependant leave, the child may continue to be included regardless of age (per p1).
By default, a 10.00 replacement charge applies (per p0); for cards reported lost through fraud, no charge applies (per p1).
By default, interest is paid at 1.5% AER up to 5,000 (per p0); for months with fewer than two active direct debits, no interest is paid (per p1).
By default, cash advances are available up to the cash limit (per p0); for accounts open fewer than 60 days, cash advances are not permitted (per p1).
By default, settlement may be applied for after five years (per p0); for applicants without eligible-category leave throughout, the route is not available (per p1).
By default, sponsorship must remain valid at the date of decision (per p0); for settlement applications, sponsorship need not remain valid at the date of decision (per p1).
By default, an 8.00 per-day fee applies (per p0); for accounts restored to credit within one business day, no fee is charged (per p1).
By default, a criminal record certificate is required (per p0); for applicants under 18, no certificate is required (per p1).
By default, worldwide travel insurance is included (per p0); for account holders aged 70 or over, no cover is provided (per p1).
By default, a 2.99% conversion charge applies (per p0).
By default, funds of 1,270 must be held for 28 consecutive days (per p0).
For instant access savings accounts, 4.50% AER variable (per p0); for fixed-term bonds, 5.20% AER (per p1).
For standard visitor visa holders, a stay of up to six months (per p0); for student visa holders, the duration of the course plus a wrap-up period (per p1).
Lounge access is included (per p0).
The applicant may apply for indefinite leave to remain (per p0).
